description: Before entering public life, Koenders was a high-level canoe-kayak competitor, multiple-time French champion and member of the French national team, competing in national and international events including European and World championships.

organization: Fonction publique (youth, sports and social cohesion services)
role: Cadre de la fonction publique (civil servant / manager)
description: Pursued a professional career as a public-sector manager in services related to youth, sports and social cohesion (jeunesse, sports et cohesion sociale).

role: Premiere adjointe au maire (first deputy mayor)
description: First deputy mayor of Dijon from 2014, serving under mayors Alain Millot and then François Rebsamen, with responsibility notably for public tranquillity and security (tranquillite publique). Held a central role in the municipal executive until being elected mayor.
Departmental councillor for Cote-d'Or, elected for the canton of Dijon-2 in 2015 and re-elected in the 2021 departmental elections.
Became first vice-president of Dijon metropole in September 2024, with responsibilities including soft mobility (mobilites actives), the cycling plan and relations with the Department.
Served briefly as acting mayor of Dijon from late July to August 2015, following the death of Mayor Alain Millot, until François Rebsamen resumed the office.

Elected mayor of Dijon by the municipal council on 25 November 2024 (47 of 59 votes) after François Rebsamen resigned the mayoralty, becoming the first woman mayor in the city's history; re-elected in her own name in March 2026. Retains personal responsibility for public tranquillity and security.
